dailyCostLimit.description: Daily limit shared by the workloads without own limits

limitProvider.description: Provider whose daily limit and spending today are shown: the one this member's runs use now (anthropic or claude-code)

memberAllowed.description: Whether the authenticated household member may use a configured provider

models.description: Model families the household can choose per workload

spentToday.description: Spent today by the workloads without own limits

AskQuestionRequest.description: A question; the client chooses the ids so that a repeated request does not ask twice

family.description: Model family for this question only; omitted uses the household's family

locale.description: Answer language when the question's is unclear

BackupHealthDto.description: The external backup as recorded by the host's backup script; codes only, never output

failureCode.description: Stable failure code, set only when the state is FAILED or UNKNOWN

defaultFamily.description: The household's model family for questions

families.description: Model families a single question can use, in a stable order

unavailableReason.description: Why a question would be refused now, for example ai.notConfigured

family.description: Model family of the run answering the question

ChooseModelRequest.description: New model family of a workload with the choice version the member saw

DiskSpaceDto.description: Free space of a disk Aegis depends on; byte values are null when it could not be measured

lowBelowBytes.description: The disk is LOW below this many free bytes

HealthCheckDto.description: One line of the overview that answers "is everything OK?"; stable codes only, the web app localizes them

area.description: Area such as database, archive, backup, storage, ai or jobs

params.description: Stable values of the reason, for example failureCode, disks, jobs, provider or failure

reason.description: Stable reason code such as backup.failed or ai.unchecked

JobHealthDto.description: Whether a recurring background job still runs; names the job only, never its data

ModelOptionDto.description: A model family with the model the Claude API uses for it and its list prices per million tokens; the owner's subscription uses the newest model of the family that Claude Code offers

attempt.description: Attempts counted against maxAttempts; waits for the next budget day do not count

cacheReadTokens.description: Input tokens the provider read from its prompt cache, not part of inputTokens

cacheWriteTokens.description: Input tokens the provider wrote to its prompt cache, not part of inputTokens

SetCostLimitsRequest.description: Daily limit and session limit (cost budget of one run) of a workload in the household currency, each a positive amount with at most two decimals and at most 1000, with the limits version the member saw

choiceChangedBy.description: Member who last changed the model choice

choiceVersion.description: Version of the model choice, sent back when changing it

dailyCostLimit.description: Daily limit that applies to this workload on the shown provider: its own limit, otherwise the provider's limit shared with the other workloads without own limits

family.description: Household model family for new runs; none for the connection check

limitsChangedBy.description: Member who last changed the cost limits

limitsSelectable.description: Whether the household can set this workload's limits; not for the connection check

limitsVersion.description: Version of the cost limits, sent back when changing them

maxCost.description: Session limit: the cost budget of one new run on the shown provider

ownLimits.description: Whether the household set this workload's daily and session limit
